assumptions: Participation is held at 2026 levels for every scenario. The membership sensitivity below shows each scenario at 5% and 10% fewer participants.

First stop, proportional scenarios: every springboard event any diver entered at 2026 Regionals or Zones (Groups C/D are required at the first stop), placed at the club’s home Region; platform counted as really entered at 2026 Regionals (non-qualifying there). This assumes every Group C/D diver who went only to 2026 Zones also attends the first stop.
First stop, 9-Zone submissions: every event entered at 2026 Regionals or Zones, platform included (platform qualifies at their first stop). These scenarios are shown exactly as stored.
Zones platform (proportional scenarios): real 2026 Zones platform entries by open entry, each placed in the Zone covering the diver’s club county.

Take-up: 96.4% of qualifiers attend Zones and 83.7% attend Junior Nationals (measured); capped rounds fill by roll-down. Prequalified/HPS athletes are not added at Junior Nationals, consistent with the other stored scenarios.
Money: entry fees only; $25 per entry to hosts for all four scenarios; DiveMeets fees passed through; no expenses, as in every Boundary Studio scenario.
